display_name: PROMIS Sleep Disturbance Short Form 8a: Total Score
description:
Calculated - Summary score for the PROMIS Sleep Disturbance Short Form 8a. Each item ranges from 1 to 5. The raw score is the sum of 8 items, and the T-score is identified by looking up total raw score in a T-score table. A T-score ³ 60 corresponded to significant sleep problems (roughly ³ 1 SD worse than average). [Yu L et al, 2012 (PMID: 22250775)](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC3261577/)

[Search for all PROMIS SD variables within this dataset](https://sleepdata.org/datasets/mesa/variables?search=promissd)
